title: Let vastness loosen your grip
summary: The same One is sung as power, gift, beauty, distance, and nearness. Vastness loosens the grip by making one angle too small to rule the whole.
takeaway: Let divine vastness make your grip feel too small to trust.
lifeApplication: When control spikes, widen your attention beyond the one thing you are trying to force; let the room, the breath, and the unseen Giver humble the demand.

source.shortMeaning: The many songs of divine power make control look smaller than reverence.
source.lifeApplication: When control spikes, widen your attention and remember who is already present.
